# Lars Jensen

> Senior IT-manager with experience in technology, strategy and leadership.

Digital Transformation | Senior IT Manager | MBA

I focus on how technology can be used, how it supports business needs, and how people and machines work best together. I am curious about how we best set the frame and direction for organizations, people and strategy in a changing world.

I try to earn the trust that a successful collaboration depends on, one built on aligned expectations, openness and psychological safety.

My experience spans development, product, business and people management. I hold a BA in Computer Sciences and an Executive MBA. Among other things, I have run Visma Digital Commerce A/S, built SaaS solutions, driven strategy and advised companies.

My ambition is to work meaningfully with the opportunities new technology gives us. I thrive on challenges and am curious about where technology, society and business are heading.

## Positions

- [Country Manager – Visma Digital Commerce A/S](https://exenova.dk/positions/country-manager-visma-digital-commerce-a-s/): Apr 2018 – Jul 2022. Ran the Danish business, answering to the group.
- [Product Manager – Visma Digital Commerce A/S](https://exenova.dk/positions/product-manager-visma-digital-commerce-a-s/): Aug 2016 – Jul 2022. Managed WPCloud, Visma Digital Commerce’s content and commerce platform, and its Nordic development team.
- [Senior Technical Business Analyst – Scalepoint](https://exenova.dk/positions/senior-technical-business-analyst-scalepoint/): Oct 2024 – Sep 2025. Analysed technical issues and advised on changes to Scalepoint’s insurance claims platform.
- [Head of Operations – Visma Esscom A/S](https://exenova.dk/positions/head-of-operations-visma-esscom-a-s/): Apr 2018 – Jul 2022. Managed employees and daily operations at Visma Esscom’s Danish subsidiary, reporting to the Swedish parent.
- [Solution Manager – Interform](https://exenova.dk/positions/solution-manager-interform/): Oct 2026 – present. Manages InterformNG2 solution packages, implementation methods and migration approaches at Interform.
- [Volunteer – Red Cross Youth](https://exenova.dk/positions/volunteer-red-cross-youth/): Jan 2000 – Dec 2015. Volunteered at Red Cross Youth’s annual holiday camp for children with disabilities and other support needs.

- [Systems Developer – TRIPLE LBi](https://exenova.dk/positions/systems-developer-triple-lbi/): Jun 2008 – Dec 2010. Coordinated frontend delivery and build systems as a technical project manager at TRIPLE LBi.

- [Self-employed – Exenova](https://exenova.dk/positions/self-employed-exenova/): Sep 2000 – Dec 2003. Ran Exenova as an independent web-development business alongside studies.
